dedupe_keys.name: pieve a nievole building stock access circulation

description: The Municipality of Pieve a Nievole publishes these 7 complementary layers describing buildings, building volumes, cadastral building use, vehicle circulation areas, external entrances and driveways and minor structures. The building and volumetric-unit definitions describe physical structures and their three-dimensional extent; the cadastral-use layer is annotated for artificial-intelligence training and comparisons with imagery to study territorial change. No specific simulation application is established by the inspected metadata. The vehicle layer identifies space available for vehicle movement and parking; it does not supply measured traffic flows. Native metadata lists Shapefile, KML, GML, GeoJSON and other representations, with free public access under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. The earlier layers have a common municipal publisher and metadata date, 2026-04-20; this date does not establish when each asset was observed. No distribution or service features were downloaded, so completeness, geometric accuracy and the availability of every declared attribute remain unverified. Existing road-boundary and cycling records are linked separately and are not counted as new components here. The added land-consumption annotation records the year a parcel passes from the land cadastre to the building cadastre when construction occurs. This is a building-registration transition, not a verified construction-completion date. It complements the building-use annotations for the same municipality. Fresh native metadata dated 2026-10-09 states CC BY 4.0; metadata dates do not establish observation dates.

notes: One resource groups complementary physical-asset layers for one municipality. Same native municipal publisher, geographic scope, technical class definitions, metadata date and licence establish the relationship; a shared hosting domain alone was not used. The name preserves the original component titles. Cadastral building-use annotations concern buildings, not generic land parcels. One complementary building-registration transition class is added, with the exact native identifier c_g636:consumo_del_suolo_ia:1. The source lineage explicitly states that transfer registers a newly built structure. Broader package counts remain unchanged; mirrors and format distributions are not counted as extra thematic classes.
